sn34.11:1.4: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti

sn34.11:1.6: samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī ca. ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho
sn34.11:1.7: ca uttamo ca pavaro ca. seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ …pe… pavaro
sn34.11:1.8: cāti. sāvatthī. cattārome bhikkhave jhāyī. katame cattāro. idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī
